notes.title: Complete update
notes.notes:
This update arrives and adds 2 achievements, content about new choices, a dialogue with Ajea, the addition of a message from the developer, the improvement of some graphic backgrounds and the correction of text. Added new audio and music files.
We hope you will like this.
New major updates will come in 2023 in addition to small weekly updates to correct minor mistakes.

A big update that will include the addition of new

I hope you'll like it, it's the first big update of the game
of the game which will arrive on December 15th.

notes.title: Important information about the game
notes.notes:
Hello dear customers,

I am creating this announcement to inform you that there was an incident that made the game released before its release date which makes it incomplete currently because still in development, the steam team has hidden the option to purchase the game and its visibility until the game is ready.

Originally the game is scheduled for October 31st at the latest, I'm deeply sorry for the inconvenience, but the game is still in development, you who bought the game before can play the game if you want but it will have many regular updates because it is in development.

Once again please accept my apologies for this blunder, if you have any questions I will always be ready to answer.
